review_sequence: 1. Obtain independently verified owner/collector/reviewer appointments per control; verify reviewer separation of duties
2. Obtain independent approval of safe, non-operational evidence scope and identity
3. Collect only authorized redacted receipts in external restricted system, with candidate/environment identifiers and SHA-256
4. Independent reviewer verifies each required positive and negative observation, scope, retention, exceptions and immutable evidence
5. Independently review H01–F11, then G12 security, operations, release approvals; do not infer GO automatically
6. Issue a separate future human GO/NO-GO decision only after all acceptance gates; this packet cannot make one
